svg.title: Root hairs compared with mould
svg.desc: Left: fine white root hairs radiating evenly from the base of every stem, the same on each. Right: patchy grey mould in dense clusters spanning between stems, with fuzzy filaments, absent in between.

g.text: Fine and even, radiating from every stem
The same halo on all of them, not in patches
Vanishes when misted, returns as it dries
Patchy - dense in spots, absent elsewhere
Does not wash away when misted
The mist test settles it: root hairs disappear when wetted, mould does not.
